# Intro {#sec-welcome}

# Player Justification

I will go in order from how I listed them above.

QB:

1. First Josh Allen, I picked Josh up in the 4th round because I believe he is the current best and most consistent QB in the league and I didn't want to pass up on getting at least one good QB. 

2. For Jalen Hurts I picked him up in the 9th round has a back up QB but before I did, I wanted to make sure to get him in that sweet spot where I was okay with my picks before him, but I also wanted to pick him up before other players could pick him up and I feel like I achieved that perfectly and got away with arguably the best QBs in the league.

RB:

1. Bijan was my 1st round pick and that was because he has been the best RB for the past 2 seasons and I see him continuing that trend.

2. CMC I got in the 2nd round as my RB2 and I know drafting him is a gamble but if you look at how good he was when he was healthy he was a top 3 RB, so I think the gamble is worth it as long as he stays healthy.

3. Bucky Irving was my 7th round pick and I picked him as safety measure in the case that CMC does get hurt this season. Last season Bucky started to pick up in his ability near the end of the season and I know he'll do the same this season.

4. Omarian was my 10th round pick and I simply picked him because he has a lot of potential and had a good off season, so I have him in case he starts to breakout.

5. Chuba Hubbard was my 12th round pick and I picked him up to get myself another RB that is consistent, if it is needed.

WR:

1. Brian Thomas Jr.was my 3rd round pick. I picked him because last season he was the biggest and most consistent player on the Jaguars and he was a high-end WR on top of that.

2. Tee Higgins was my 5th round pick and I picked him up because again he was a high-end WR last season who kept going back and forth with Ja'marr Chase, who is one of the best WR in the league.

3. Mike Evans was my 6th round pick. I picked Mike Evans because he is the definition of consistency, last season was his 7th season in a row of getting over a 1,000 receiving yards.

4. Ladd McConkey was my 8th round pick and I picked him up because last season if the Chargers were throwing the ball it was going to Ladd I believe he will still receive the same work load.

5. DeVonte Smith was my 13th round pick and I picked him because if A.J. Brown gets hurt, then DeVonte is almost a must start because he will be the go to target in case of an A.J. injury.

TE:

13. T.J. Hockenson was my was my 11th round pick and I drafted him because he is a relatively consistent TE that could surprise every now and then. I also feel he will be used as safety net for J.J. McCarthy.

K:

1. Chris Boswell was my 14th pick and I picked him up because if there is one thing the Steelers are good at it's getting into field goal range and I plan to utilize that.

D/ST:

1. My final pick of the Draft was the Detroit Lions defense, I picked Detroit because their defense is usually a safe pick that at worst will only give you zero points.

# Teams Strengths and Weaknesses

Strengths:

As you might be able to see my teams strengths are my QB and RB rooms. I have 2 of the best QBs and I have 2 of the most dominant RB if CMC stays healthy. I also have at least 3 good WR that I could use inter changeably.

Weaknesses:

It's not hard to see that my teams weaknesses are the lack of a TE room, and my defense could be changed throughout the season because the Lions are know for getting hurt quite a bit. 

# My Teams Plan

The Plan for my team is to have my QB and RBs achieve the bulk of my points and have them supported by my WRs and Kicker. The hope for my WRs is that they will be able to achieve a consistent base line of at the least 12 points, given the fact I have 3 good inter changeable WRs I expect to be able to get near or reach that goal of 12 points. My kickers I see as only a plus side in my opinion, just hope he gets as many points as possible. I do view my TE and Defense as sort of lucky little accidents. If they do good they do good but I am not relying on them, I just hope they don't go negative. I think this way because I already know I will have to pick up a new TE and Defense eventually, for off-weeks.

# Team Prediction

My prediction for my team is that I do believe I can win the league. I give myself personally about 35% - 40% chance. I give myself this chance because I do believe I have the biggest game changers out of any other team. Josh and Jalen are amazing QBs and Bijan and CMC are easily the best RBs. The only reason I believe I wouldn't win is simply because of me personally making a wrong decision, this is only my second season ever playing fantasy football and I am still error prone. If my team doesn't win I believe I'll be at the minimum 2nd place.
